note: Hand-written whole-league recap, one per week, rendered at the TOP of the Scores tab above the match grid. Distinct from matchup-commentary-2026.json, which is the per-game write-up hanging off the foot of each card. Voice matches Phase 8/9: Hall of Fame & Shame roast level, punch at the decision not the person. Facts must come from scripts/build_matchup_facts.py -- check every number before it goes in.

shape.headline: one line, the week in a sentence
shape.facts: optional array of {k, v} -- the at-a-glance strip. 3-5 entries reads best; more than 6 wraps badly on mobile.
shape.paragraphs: array of strings, one per paragraph. 2-3 paragraphs / ~200-250 words is the target: longer than a matchup write-up, shorter than a season recap.

survivor_note: Do NOT write the survivor eliminations in here. The tracker under each recap is computed live from the scoreboard by computeSurvivor() in index.html -- a hand-typed elimination list would only drift from the scores rendered directly beneath it.

1.headline: The worst record in league history opens with the best Week 1 score the league has ever seen
paragraphs: Jared Hayes came into 2026 with an 11-31 head-to-head record, the worst in the league, and opened it with 214.46 — the highest Week 1 score The Other League has ever produced and the fifth-highest regular-season total of all time. It came with Colston Loveland posting 0.00 and Jaylen Waddle 0.70 in the starting lineup, which is either a warning to the rest of the league or proof that none of this is sustainable. Caleb Williams and Trevor Lawrence combined for 63.36 at quarterback, and the defending champion was the one standing in front of it.

Jake Bogardus beat Mitch Blackwell by 108.46, the second-widest margin in league history, behind only a 125.88 beating in 2023. Mitch's entire bench combined for 33.52, so there was no rescue sitting on it either. Matt Bova finished even lower at 85.77, starting Sam Darnold for 0.52 and Romeo Doubs for a flat zero, and the best possible lineup would still have lost to Chris Bova by 33.

Elsewhere the median game did its usual work. Erin Jacobs scored 158.23, more than the winners of two other games, and lost to Chris Merkel anyway. Nick Bova went the other way: 131.79, the most points left on any bench, and a first win over Duane Gillenwater in six regular-season tries. Five teams leave Week 1 at 2-0 — Hayes, Bogardus, both Merkels, and Chris Bova — while Andrew Bova, who entered the week as the all-time head-to-head leader, got 37.66 from Josh Allen and sits at 0-2.

2.headline: Two 0-2 teams post two of the week's three best scores, and both finally get paid for it
paragraphs: The league underperformed its projections by almost 25 points a team, and two of the three managers who ignored the memo had started 0-2. Jake Blackwell put up 181.29, the best score of the week, with 58.26 from Jared Goff and Brock Purdy and 34.20 from Amon-Ra St. Brown, and beat Nick Bova for the first time in five tries. Andrew Bova, last week's 37.66-and-no-help story, got 42.82 from Josh Allen, 29.76 from Dak Prescott and 50.25 from two tight ends, and handed Jake Bogardus his first loss by 39.90. Mitch Blackwell got 42.00 from Jaxon Smith-Njigba and 99.73 in total, and still lost by 80.38 to Chris Bova, whose running backs outscored Mitch's 51.40 to 3.85.

Two Merkels stayed perfect in the head-to-head column while losing to the median. Chris Merkel started Jaxson Dart for 0.80 with Matthew Stafford's 26.98 on the bench and was bailed out by 40.00 from Davante Adams. Nick Merkel won with 111.01, the lowest winning score of the week, on Saquon Barkley's 3.00 and a negative from DJ Moore, because Duane Gillenwater could only find 98.28.

Jared Hayes posted his lowest score of the season, left 51.60 on the bench, benched Tyler Shough (22.38) for Trevor Lawrence (6.16) for the second straight week, and won anyway. He and Chris Bova are the only 4-0 teams in the league. Matt Bova, Mitch Blackwell and Duane Gillenwater are 0-4, and Matt's 95.87 was the lowest score of the week for the second week running.
